from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = [
            "Greedy strategies pick the most likely word.",
            "Max Entropy picks the best search space reducer.",
            "One eliminates 90%, the other only 10%."
        ]
        self.setup_layout("Algorithmic Analysis: Greedy Search vs. Optimal Path", lecture_lines)
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Labyrinth asset for search space
        labyrinth = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/labyrinth.svg", color="#8A2BE2")
        self.place_at_grid(labyrinth, "C4", scale_factor=0.6)
        
        root = Circle(radius=0.2, color="#8A2BE2", fill_opacity=1)
        self.place_at_grid(root, "C4", scale_factor=0.9)
        
        tree = VGroup(labyrinth, root)
        
        # Add some child nodes
        for i, pos in enumerate(["D2", "D6"]):
            child = Circle(radius=0.15, color="#8A2BE2", fill_opacity=1)
            self.place_at_grid(child, pos)
            line = Line(root.get_center(), child.get_center(), color=WHITE)
            tree.add(line, child)
            
        self.play(Create(tree))
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#8A2BE2")
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Compass asset for orientation
        compass = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/compass.svg", color="#00FFFF")
        self.place_at_grid(compass, "B6", scale_factor=0.5)

        greedy_path = Line(root.get_center(), self.grid["D2"], color="#00FFFF", stroke_width=4)
        optimum_path = Line(root.get_center(), self.grid["D6"], color="#FFD700", stroke_width=4)
        
        greedy_label = Text("Greedy", font_size=20, color="#00FFFF")
        self.place_at_grid(greedy_label, "D2", scale_factor=0.7)
        
        optimum_label = Text("Optimum", font_size=20, color="#FFD700")
        self.place_at_grid(optimum_label, "D6", scale_factor=0.7)
        
        self.play(Create(greedy_path), Create(optimum_path), Write(greedy_label), Write(optimum_label), FadeIn(compass))
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#00FFFF")
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Flash node selected by algorithm
        flash = Dot(radius=0.3, color="#FF69B4")
        self.place_at_grid(flash, "D5", scale_factor=0.6)
        
        self.play(Flash(flash, color="#FF69B4", line_length=0.2, num_lines=12))
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#FF69B4")
        self.wait(1)
        
        self.play(FadeOut(tree), FadeOut(greedy_path), FadeOut(optimum_path), FadeOut(greedy_label), FadeOut(optimum_label), FadeOut(flash), FadeOut(compass))

class Section4Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Practical Application: Why 'CRANE' or 'SALET'?", [
            "Starting words like CRANE are mathematically superior.",
            "They maximize vowel frequency and common consonants.",
            "This provides the highest information gain per turn."
        ])
        
        # [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/crane.svg]
        crane_icon = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/crane.svg")
        self.place_at_grid(crane_icon, "A6", scale_factor=0.3)
        self.add(crane_icon)

        # --- Preparation ---
        letters = ["A", "R", "N", "E", "S", "T"]
        frequencies = [0.12, 0.10, 0.09, 0.13, 0.11, 0.08]
        bars = VGroup()
        for i, (l, f) in enumerate(zip(letters, frequencies)):
            bar = Rectangle(height=f*10, width=0.5, color="#32CD32", fill_opacity=0.8)
            label = Text(l, font_size=20).next_to(bar, UP)
            bar_group = VGroup(bar, label)
            bars.add(bar_group)
        bars.arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.2)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color("#FFD700"))
        # Fix 29/44: Encroachment
        self.place_in_area(bars, 'D3', 'F6', scale_factor=0.6)
        self.play(Create(bars), run_time=2)
        self.wait(3)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(WHITE), self.lecture[1].animate.set_color("#32CD32"))
        word = Text("CRANE", font_size=48, color=WHITE)
        # Fix 30/45: Disjointed flow
        self.place_at_grid(word, 'B3', scale_factor=1.0)
        self.play(Write(word))
        self.wait(3)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(WHITE), self.lecture[2].animate.set_color("#FF1493"))
        
        # Fix 31/46: Target overlap/anchoring
        target = Circle(radius=0.3, color="#FF1493", fill_opacity=0.5)
        self.place_at_grid(target, 'C3', scale_factor=0.8)
        target_label = Text("Max Entropy", font_size=20, color="#FF1493").next_to(target, RIGHT)
        
        self.play(
            word.animate.move_to(target.get_center()),
            FadeIn(target),
            Write(target_label)
        )
        self.wait(4)
        
        # [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/crane.svg]
        self.play(
            FadeOut(bars),
            FadeOut(word),
            FadeOut(target),
            FadeOut(target_label)
        )
        self.wait(2)

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = [
            "Optimal play is not about guessing immediately.",
            "It is about maximizing information gain early.",
            "This collapses uncertainty rapidly to solve the word."
        ]
        self.setup_layout("Summary and Conclusion", lecture_lines)
        
        # Elements (Consistent with grid constraints - avoiding columns 1-3, rows A/F)
        entropy = Text("Entropy", font_size=32, color="#FFD700")
        strategy = Text("Strategy", font_size=32, color="#FFD700")
        efficiency = Text("Efficiency", font_size=32, color="#FFD700")
        
        # Grid positioning - utilizing right side (cols 4-6)
        self.place_at_grid(entropy, 'C4', scale_factor=0.6)
        self.place_at_grid(strategy, 'D5', scale_factor=0.6)
        self.place_at_grid(efficiency, 'E4', scale_factor=0.6)
        
        pillars = VGroup(entropy, strategy, efficiency)
        
        connections = VGroup(
            Line(entropy.get_center(), strategy.get_center(), color="#40E0D0"),
            Line(strategy.get_center(), efficiency.get_center(), color="#40E0D0"),
            Line(efficiency.get_center(), entropy.get_center(), color="#40E0D0")
        )

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color("#FFD700"))
        self.play(FadeIn(entropy))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color("#FFD700"))
        self.play(FadeIn(strategy), FadeIn(efficiency))
        self.play(Create(connections))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color("#FFD700"))
        self.play(Indicate(pillars), Indicate(connections))
        self.wait(2)

outline.topic: Optimal Wordle Strategy: Entropy and Information Theory

sections.title: Introduction: The Guessing Game Challenge
sections.content: Define Wordle as a search problem in a finite state space of 2,315 possible answers. Introduce the goal: minimizing the average number of guesses using information theory.
sections.example: Imagine a detective (The Solver) trying to identify a secret animal code out of 2,315 candidates. Each guess is an interrogation.

sections.title: Mathematical Foundation: Entropy as Information Gain
sections.content: Explain that every guess provides feedback (Green/Yellow/Gray). Prerequisite: Define Entropy H(X) = -Σ p(x)log2 p(x). Visually represent this as a decision tree branch splitting probabilities.
sections.example: A guess like 'CRANE' acts as a filter: it partitions the 2,315 words into subsets based on possible color patterns, aiming to maximize the 'expected surprise'.

sections.title: Algorithmic Analysis: Greedy Search vs. Optimal Path
sections.content: Contrast a 'Greedy' strategy (picking the most likely remaining word) with the 'Max Entropy' strategy (picking the word that reduces the remaining search space most efficiently).
sections.example: Compare a robot choosing a word that eliminates 90% of candidates versus one that only eliminates 10%, visualizing the narrowing search area on a screen.

sections.title: Practical Application: Why 'CRANE' or 'SALET'?
sections.content: Analyze why specific starting words are mathematically superior. They maximize vowel frequency and common consonant positioning, providing the highest average information gain per turn.
sections.example: Visual overlay of a heat map showing character frequency across the 2,315-word dictionary, highlighting why 'S', 'A', 'R', 'E' are the 'Golden Keys'.

sections.title: Summary and Conclusion
sections.content: Recap: Optimal play is not about guessing the word immediately; it is about maximizing the information gained in the first two turns to collapse the uncertainty of the system.
sections.example: Final screen: An animation showing a 'cloud of possibilities' shrinking rapidly from 2,315 to 1, then 0, after an optimal 'CRANE' start.
